title: NotebookLM

body.text: NotebookLM is a research assistant that
answers only from the sources you upload (no guessing beyond the documents)
— add PDFs, Google Docs, links, or YouTube, then ask, summarize, or create an Audio Overview to listen to like a podcast.

example: "Upload 3 annual reports + 5 news articles, then ask: how did the company's strategy change over 3 years, and from which sources?"

title: How it differs from regular Gemini

body.text: Gemini answers from general knowledge + the web / NotebookLM answers from your documents and points to the citation
— for work where accuracy is tied to specific documents, like company manuals or textbooks, use NotebookLM.

example: "Asking about the company's leave policy → NotebookLM loaded with the employee handbook answers and points to the page, no web guessing"

options.text: Only the sources you upload, with citation locations
